summary.text: Davon Magwood is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 55, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jill Cooper.
A Pittsburgh native and chef who ran for the seat in 2024, he described himself in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey as a stand-up comedian and screenwriter running on housing, wages and education.

paragraphs.text: Davon Magwood was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and earned a high school diploma from Schenley High School, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his career experience as working as a chef.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father of three who grew up in government housing, worked as a chef and line cook, and works as a stand-up comedian and screenwriter.
Magwood was the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House District 55 in 2024, when incumbent Jill Cooper defeated him in the general election, 67.6 percent to 32.1 percent.
In that survey he named affordable housing and renters' rights, raising the minimum wage, and increased state funding for public schools as his key messages.
